hooks.name: Dream memory readiness
hooks.description: Report whether memory changed since the last consolidation. Starts no LLM job.

action.command: if [ ! -e .kiro/dreaming/.last-dream ] || [ -n "$(find .kiro/dreaming/topics -name '*.md' -newer .kiro/dreaming/.last-dream 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo 'Memory: notes were captured since the last consolidation. Run the dream skill now, before the user request, then continue.'; fi
